title: An Ally from the Organization/Quotes
summary:
"Grier's different from the rest of the Organization. Dante has a lot of respect for him... and so do I."
- Lok Lambert to Den Fears

"Dante wouldn't come to me if it wasn't important."
- Grier to Lok Lambert

"We should be in there! What's Grier got we don't?" (Den Fears)

"Den, please understand. Fighting side by side is important to them. This is a test of trust." (Sophie Casterwill)

"Thinking of moving into the castle? I'll warn you - the rent's high."
- Dante Vale to Wilder

"Do not be so sure. I followed the Professor and I refuse to let Huntik Foundation punks run through his castle like they own the place!"
- Hoffman to Den Fears

"Do not be so sure. I followed the Professor, and I refuse to let Huntik Foundation punks run through his castle like they own the place!"
- Hoffman to Den Fears

"In the Professor's name, stop those two!"
- Hoffman to the Elite Suit's about Dante and Grier

"Sorry, I'm stubborn when I make up my mind."
- Hoffman to Dante
